acceptance.failure: If any observation or absolute return cannot be confirmed, stop after the one planned absolute command. Do not send fine correction, a second absolute command, a preset command or a stop fallback.
acceptance.success: One AbsoluteMove to the read initial pan/tilt position produces a fresh quiet frame with overlap at least 0.85 and canonical visual displacement at most 3 px.

hypothesis: Published absolute pan/tilt coordinates can provide a safer coarse return primitive than a preset on a camera whose preset inventory is full, while visual evidence remains the only success criterion.
